[SWS_CRYPT_20618]
{DRAFT}
⌈
In the
CryptoAPI
context, the certificate store is
protected from unauthorized access and tampering. This can be done by cryptographic
mechanism, such as providing an
MAC
, or by storing the certificates in a secure storage,
such as a
TPM
.
⌋
(RS_CRYPTO_02306)
